newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil tracks benchmark futures lower.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil tracks benchmark futures lower.

text.p: NWE gas oil weakened on Monday in line with weaker benchmark IPE futures in a fairly dull market, traders said.
June IPE gas oil settled $4.25 later at $160.00 a tonne, while the July contract ended $4.00 off at $161.75.

Heating oil barges saw the most activity. Two parcels of 1,000 tonnes each traded at June IPE +$1.0 fob Rotterdam June 10-25 delivery in early trade, while a small fob Flushing parcel fetched June IPE +50 cents.
Later, a German player sold 2,000 tonnes at June IPE +$1.50 cif Germany and a parcel traded at June IPE +$1.25 fob Rott.
Low sulphur material traded at June IPE +$7.25 fob Flushing in early trade.
Traders said many buyers appeared to be holding back from purchasing material in the expectation futures could fall further.

"It's been pretty quiet as always when futures go down everyone holds out for further losses," said one trader. "I think $160 could be the bottom so I wouldn't be surprised if it got a bit livelier tomorrow," one trader said.
On the cargo front, the market was described as "extremely quiet." -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
